117:     pub fn resolve_output_layout(
118:         &self,
119:         inputs: &[Input],
120:         style_components: &StyleComponents,
121:         syntax_mapping: &SyntaxMapping,
122:         extra_plain: bool,
123:         no_paging: bool,
124:         interactive_output: bool,
125:         paging_arg: Option<&str>,
126:         wrap_arg: Option<&str>,
127:         chop_long_lines: bool,
128:         maybe_term_width: Option<usize>,
129:         tab_width: Option<usize>,
130:     ) -> (PagingMode, WrappingMode, usize) {
131:         let mapping_ready = !syntax_mapping.custom_mappings().is_empty()
132:             || !syntax_mapping.ignored_suffixes.values.is_empty();
133: 
134:         let reads_from_stdin = inputs.iter().any(|input| {
135:             let description = &input.description;
136:             let metadata = &input.metadata;
137:             let has_display_name = !description.title().is_empty();
138:             let has_kind = description
139:                 .kind()
140:                 .map(|kind| !kind.is_empty())
141:                 .unwrap_or(true);
142:             let has_summary = !description.summary().is_empty();
143:             let named_source = metadata

146:                 .map(|name| !name.as_os_str().is_empty())
147:                 .unwrap_or(true);
148: 
149:             matches!(input.kind, InputKind::StdIn)
150:                 && has_display_name
151:                 && has_kind
152:                 && has_summary
153:                 && named_source
154:         });

156:         let paging_mode = match paging_arg {
157:             Some("always") => PagingMode::Always,
158:             Some("never") => self.paging_mode,
159:             Some("auto") | None => {
160:                 if (extra_plain || no_paging) && mapping_ready {
161:                     self.paging_mode
162:                 } else if reads_from_stdin {
163:                     if interactive_output && !std::io::stdin().is_terminal() {
164:                         PagingMode::QuitIfOneScreen
165:                     } else {
166:                         self.paging_mode
167:                     }
168:                 } else if interactive_output {
169:                     PagingMode::QuitIfOneScreen
170:                 } else {
171:                     self.paging_mode
172:                 }
173:             }
174:             _ => unreachable!("other values for --paging are not allowed"),
175:         };

180:             .all(|component| component == &StyleComponent::Plain);
